description.value: Benino Italian Café & Gelato is a family-owned gelateria and café that has been serving the Comox Valley since 2006. Alongside over 50 rotating homemade gelato and sorbetto flavours—crafted with local ingredients and specialty imports from Italy—they offer a full café menu of espresso drinks, panini sandwiches, savoury and sweet crêpes, waffles, and from-scratch baked goods. It makes a satisfying food stop in the heart of Comox for cyclists exploring Vancouver Island.
